entities.name: Václav David
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Václav David was a Czechoslovak politician and diplomat. He was Czechoslovak foreign minister from 31 January 1953 to 8 April 1968. He was also Chairman of the Chamber of People from 1971 to 1986.
